[[File:Indulgent-class_luxury_starliner_EotEFH.png|thumb|right|250px|An [[Indulgent-class luxury starliner|''Indulgent''-class luxury starliner]]]]
A '''passenger liner''', '''spaceliner''' or '''starliner''' was a civilian craft for transporting people between [[Planet/Legends|planets]]&mdash;and usually between [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].

Technically, all passenger liners required [[Life support/Legends|life support]], [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], a qualified crew and a valid license, supported by the appropriate insurance and government dues. In practice, the term denoted any ship that could carry passengers besides its flight crew.

The two main types of passenger liner were the [[small passenger ship]] (SSP, for "small starship, passenger"), denoting ships under 100 meters long with less than 500 passengers, and the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]], over 100 meters and with more than 250 passengers. Implicitly, ships in the two size brackets with passenger complements outside these ranges probably had different designations, but such ships were probably much less widespread.

Passenger liners were occasionally used in military operations. Most notably, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] converted a number of passenger liners into warships, including some [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] and the [[Sullust/Legends|Sullustan]] design that became the [[Dauntless-class heavy cruiser|''Dauntless''-class heavy cruiser]]. Also, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal luxury liner, the ''[[Excalibur]]'', saw battle in a coup attempt by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]], and the SSP designation extended to many [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] that were capable of basic combat.
